versions.changelog:
Initial release: concise, beginner-friendly guide to workflow automation using a three-step framework.

- Covers automation fundamentals: Trigger, Action, Error Handling—all in under a minute.
- Introduces a three-step core method: Identify, Design, Build.
- Includes quick checklists, workflow templates, and design/testing guidelines.
- Provides three common beginner scenarios and an FAQ.
- Entirely in Chinese, with localized explanations and examples.
- Advanced features, multi-step frameworks, and expert guides are available in the pro version.
